question: A research team is studying certain congenital anomalies of the respiratory tract. The method consists of marking a certain germinal layer with an isotope, following its development stages in chicken embryos, and finally analyzing the specimen. A given specimen of tissue is presented in the exhibit. Which of the following germinal structures most likely gave rise to the epithelial lining of this specimen?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Endoderm -> epithelial lining of the respiratory tract -> 80% CHAIN: Surface ectoderm -> epithelial lining of the respiratory tract -> 70% CHAIN: Ectoderm -> epithelial lining of the respiratory tract -> 60% CHAIN: Mesoderm -> epithelial lining of the respiratory tract -> 50% CHAIN: Neural crest -> epithelial lining of the respiratory tract -> 80%
analysis: The epithelial lining of the respiratory tract typically arises from the endoderm layer during embryonic development.
